a4HpState.label: HP at 50% or more
a4HpState.reason: His own plunges and Burst heal him, so he usually stays at half HP or more, where his Charmed Cloudstrider plunge deals 20% more damage.

c2Overheal.label: Constellation 2 after overhealing
c2Overheal.reason: A Constellation 2 ATK bonus for 5 seconds after healing beyond full HP, which depends on the team's healing.
